title: Double Dhamaal
desc: Four idlers make elaborate plans to earn money by investing in buildings but are conned by Kabir, who leaves them unemployed and penniless. Soon, they are on the prowl to avenge their humiliation.

title: Toofan
desc: Separated at birth, the paths of Shyam, a lousy magician unwittingly roped into a crime, and Toofan, a defender of the people, cross again years later as they reunite to avenge their father.

title: Ek Rishtaa: The Bond of Love
desc: Amid the ideological differences with his father Vijay, Ajay steps up to protect his family from Rajesh's, his brother-in-law's, evil intentions.

title: Kasam Hindustan Ki
desc: Dhuruvan is a forest ranger who trains NCC cadets. On a trek with five college girls, he stumbles upon a gang of terrorists who plan to foil a rocket launch by ISRO.

title: Tirangaa
desc: Brigadier Suryadev Singh and Shivajirao Waghle, a police inspector, work together to track down a terrorist who plans to evade India.
